title: Suspension fixtures and external supports for a long-shaft pit furnace
summary: Suspending a long shaft through the central lid opening does not mean its weight should rest on the lid. Two Suneng gas-fired pit furnace documents place the external supports of the lifting fixture on brackets at either side of the furnace platform. The lid comprises two semicircular halves that move apart. Show workpiece suspension, external supports and lid movement separately, then confirm who designs and fabricates the fixtures.
